<h1>像素拆解用什么模型生成的？</h1>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">用的是谷歌<strong>Nano Banana Pro</strong>模型，它基于谷歌强大的Gemini 3 Pro构建，具备更强的逻辑推理能力和世界知识，能理解复杂指令和物理规律。支持原生2K和4K分辨率输出，满足专业印刷需求。提供专业级的局部编辑功能，可调整相机角度、景深、光照等。增强了文字渲染能力，突破性地解决了上一版本中AI图像中文字模糊、错误的问题，不过对于中文的准确性还不是100%，你在使用中会发现渲染的不是很正确。</div>
</div>

<h1>怎么使用？</h1>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">由于是国外模型，大部分国内普通用户无法在谷歌（https://gemini.google.com/）体验，则可以通过StyleAi免费使用Nano Banana Pro模型。StyleAI是Ai图片视频生成网站，国内用户可直接使用（除了福建），里面有Nano Banana Pro，Nano banana，Sora2，Veo3.0模型。新用户5积分，随后每日3积分，每天重置不叠加。</div>

<h2 class="Editable-styled">&nbsp;</h2>
<h1>像素级拆解提示词</h1>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">
<p><strong>角色设定</strong></p>
<p>你是一位顶尖的游戏与动漫概念美术设计大师，擅长制作详尽的角色设定图。你具备“像素级拆解”的能力，能够透视角色的穿着层级、捕捉微表情变化，并将与其相关的物品进行具象化还原。</p>
<p><strong>任务目标</strong></p>
<p>根据用户上传或描述的主体形象，生成一张“全景式角色深度概念分解图”。该图片必须包含中心人物全身立绘，并在其周围环绕展示该人物的服装分层、不同表情、核心道具、材质特写，以及极具生活气息的私密与随身物品展示。</p>
<p><strong>视觉规范</strong></p>
<p>1. 构图布局 :</p>
<p>• 中心位 : 放置角色的全身立绘或主要动态姿势，作为视觉锚点。</p>
<p> • 环绕位 : 在中心人物四周空白处，有序排列拆解后的元素。</p>
<p> • 视觉引导 : 使用手绘箭头或引导线，将周边的拆解物品与中心人物的对应部位或所属区域（如包包连接手部）连接起来。</p>
<br>
<p>2. 拆解内容 —— 核心迭代区域:</p>
<p>服装分层 :</p>
<p>• 将角色的服装拆分为单品展示。如果是多层穿搭，需展示脱下外套后的内层状态。</p>
<p>• 新增：私密内里拆解 : 独立展示角色的内层衣物，重点突出设计感与材质。</p>
<p>表情集 :</p>
<p>• 在角落绘制 3-4 个不同的头部特写，展示不同的情绪。</p>
<p>材质特写 :</p>
<p>• 选取 1-2 个关键部位进行放大特写。</p>
<p>• 新增：物品质感特写，对小物件材质的描绘。</p>
<p>关联物品 :</p>
<p>• 此处不再局限于大型道具，需增加展示角色的“生活切片”。
</p>
<p>• 随身包袋与内容物 : 绘制角色的日常通勤包或手拿包，并将其“打开”，展示散落在旁的物品，符合其职业、爱好、性格和生活习惯的个人物品。</p>
<p>• 美妆与护理 : 展示符合其角色的化妆品组合。</p>
<p>• 私密生活物件 : 不能随意向外人展现的物品，最能代表其私密生活、情感寄托或内心世界。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3. 风格与注释 :</p>
<p>• 画风: 保持高质量的 2D 插画风格或概念设计草图风格，线条干净利落。</p>
<p>• 背景: 使用米黄色、羊皮纸或浅灰色纹理背景，营造设计手稿的氛围。</p>
<p>• 文字说明: 在每个拆解元素旁模拟手写注释，简要说明材质或品牌/型号暗示。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>执行逻辑</strong></p>
<p>当用户提供一张图片或描述时：
</p>
<p>1. 分析主体的核心特征、穿着风格及潜在性格。</p>
<p>2. 提取可拆解的一级元素（外套、鞋子、大表情）。</p>
<p>3. 脑补并设计二级深度元素（内衣风格？包里会有什么私密物品？）。</p>
<p>4. 生成一张包含所有这些元素的组合图，确保透视准确，光影统一，注释清晰。
5. 使用中文。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 class="Editable-styled">&nbsp;</h2>
<h1>Nano Banana Pro API接入教程</h1>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">对于想要将相关功能集成到自己应用或进行批量创作的开发者，可以通过API进行调用。这里提供两种主流的接入方式。</div>

</div>
<h3 class="Editable-styled">&nbsp;</h3>
<h2>官方接入</h2>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">1. 获取 API 密钥</div>

</div>
<ul>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">访问&nbsp;<span class="nolink">Google AI Studio（<a class="Link ztext-link" href="http://aistudio.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">aistudio.google.com/</a>）</span></div>

</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">在左侧模型选择器中选择&nbsp;Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro 图像)</div>

</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">打开&nbsp;API 密钥管理&nbsp;界面，复制您的 API 密钥</div>

</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">启用计费功能，在 API 密钥管理页面，点击项目旁边的&nbsp;"设置计费"，按照提示完成计费设置</div>

</li>

</ul>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">2.安装 SDK</div>

</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">Python 安装：</div>

</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install -U <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">google-genai&gt;=1.52.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>pip install Pillow  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图像处理库</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">Node.js 安装：</div>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> @google/genai</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">3. 基础图像生成</div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">初始化客户端</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> google <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> genai
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> google.genai <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> types

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型ID</span>
PRO_MODEL_ID = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gemini-3-pro-image-preview</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>

<div class="Editable-unstyled">

                aspect_ratio</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aspect_ratio,
            )
        )
    )

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 图片已保存为 generated_cat.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generated_cat.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> None</pre>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>2. GrsAI 国内直连接口</h2>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">都知道官方接口价格死贵，一张1-2k图￥0.96，4k图￥1.7，普通企业、独立开发怎么承受得了这种价格？那么去哪里找便宜稳定的Nano Banana Pro接口？</div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">GrsAi作为Ai大模型APi源头供应商，提供Nano Banana Pro官方格式调用1k 2k 4k分辨率图均为0.09/张。并且生成失败不扣积分原路返还。</div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">1. 获取 API 密钥</div>
<ul>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">访问GrsAi APi ：<a class="Link ztext-link" href="https://grsai.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://GrsAi.com</a></div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">进入控制台</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">左侧找到APIKey，点击创建</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">查看不同模型对应开发文档</div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">方式一：直接绘图接口（推荐）</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">这是最简单的接入方式，一次调用即可完成图片生成。</div>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> requestsimport jsonimport time<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置信息API_KEY = "你的API密钥"HOST = "https://grsai.dakka.com.cn"  # 国内直连节点# HOST = "https://api.grsai.com"    # 海外节点# 生成像素拆解图片def generate_pixel_analysis():</span>
    url = f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{HOST}/v1/draw/nano-banana</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    
    headers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Content-Type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application/json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer {API_KEY}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建请求数据</span>
    payload =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nano-banana-pro</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用Pro版本，效果最好</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prompt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">动漫角色像素级拆解，展示服装分层、表情变化、道具细节，爆炸视图风格，概念设计图</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">aspectRatio</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1:1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">imageSize</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2K</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选：1K, 2K, 4K</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">urls</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://example.com/your-reference-image.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>],  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 参考图URL</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shutProgress</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: True  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接返回最终结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送请求</span>
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=120<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code == 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.json()
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查状态</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> result.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">succeeded</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                image_url </span>= result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">results</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 生成成功！图片地址: {image_url}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> image_url            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ 生成失败: {result.get('error', '未知错误')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 请求失败: {response.status_code}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误信息: {response.text}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 请求异常: {str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> None<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用示例if __name__ == "__main__":</span>
    image_url =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> generate_pixel_analysis()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> image_url:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里可以下载图片或进行后续处理</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">图片已生成，有效期为2小时</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">方式二：WebHook回调方式（适合异步处理）</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr">当生成时间较长时，可以使用回调方式避免超时。</div>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requestsimport json
API_KEY </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你的API密钥</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>HOST = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://grsai.dakka.com.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>WEBHOOK_URL = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://your-server.com/callback</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 你的回调地址def generate_with_webhook():</span>
    url = f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{HOST}/v1/draw/nano-banana</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    
    headers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Content-Type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application/json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer {API_KEY}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    
    payload </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nano-banana-pro</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">prompt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">潮流穿搭像素拆解，展示外套、内搭、裤子、鞋子的分层细节</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">urls</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://example.com/fashion-image.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">webHook</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: WEBHOOK_URL  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置回调地址</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
    
    response </span>= requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">payload)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code == 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        task_info </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.json()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> task_info.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            task_id </span>= task_info[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 任务已提交，ID: {task_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task_id    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">❌ 任务提交失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> None<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回调接口示例（你的服务器需要实现的）"""</span>
@app.route(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/callback</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, methods=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handle_callback():
    data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> request.json
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> data.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">succeeded</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        image_url </span>= data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">results</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理生成的图片</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">收到生成的图片: {image_url}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> jsonify({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 0})
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span></pre>
